scripts.syntax-check: node -c main.js preload.js services/projects.js ../services/vscodeShim.js ../services/fsUtils.js ../services/scanners.js ../services/actions.js ../services/updater.js ../webview/js/state.js ../webview/js/syncEta.js ../webview/js/ipc.js ../webview/js/controls.js ../webview/js/actions.js ../webview/js/pluginDetails.js ../webview/js/cards.js ../webview/js/activeContext.js ../webview/js/modals.js ../webview/js/main.js ../locales/translations.js && node -e "const fsUtils = require('../services/fsUtils'); const path = require('path'); const script = fsUtils.getWebviewScript(path.join(__dirname, '../webview')); const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('temp_bundle_check.js', script); require('child_process').execSync('node -c temp_bundle_check.js'); fs.unlinkSync('temp_bundle_check.js'); console.log('Concatenated webview bundle check: PASS');"
